selection: the four views of a process catch
description: The start, main, detail and result page of a process catch, which guide the user of a question phrase e.g. the PV calculator from one easy question to the result; the fields of each page are defined by the field triples of the question phrase (process_catch_fields.json). This file is imported as the last step of the db setup, so that no database id of a tested view or component moves.

triples.description: the place that the user has entered in the geolocator e.g. to select the sun intensity of a PV calculator
